turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Grandma, it's me. I'll pick you up around six tonight.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sounds great, do you want to eat at the usual place?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure, or we could try that new Italian place if you're up for it. Do you need anything from the store on my way?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Could you grab some milk? Thank you, sweetheart.
